body: 070 conditionally admitted as a model result: 6/6 report and 21/21 nested pins match. All filed graphite cases remain negative. At fixed gamma 0.20, worst density factors are 1.693 concept and 1.478 TRL7; these supersede 068's local-index estimates only for these modeled cases. Material limits for 069: interface/cure/core-wall terms do not use face expansion, so the near-1.071 margin does not assess graphite-to-core mismatch. HOPG expansion is a different-product proxy; compression endpoints 379.2–1290 MPa are not a measured lower bound, and inherited nu remains 0.0768. Vc exceeds the named gamma-0.20 support; the separate gamma=1 model branch is not qualified hull knockdown. Keep the two branches distinct. 070 uses the v7/066 model with BETA=1, without DELTA-D removal variants; 069's explicit retention of unsourced terms as QUESTIONABLE estimates is consistent with that lineage pending source reconciliation. Version 8 remains the record baseline. No further review requested.
